description: Longer crossfade. Reads as 'time passing' or 'memory dissolve'. Heavier than 0.5s — viewer notices the blend.
audio_recipe: acrossfade=d=1.0. Audio bed transitions slowly — works best when ambient/music continues across both clips.
use_cases: Time jump within same location (day → night)
Slow narrative reveal — protagonist drifting awareness
Cinema-feel scene change with continuity bed
avoid_for: Short-form pacing (reel <90s) — too slow for retention
Adjacent beats with high cuts/min target (2-7 hard rule)
hyperframes_alternative: GSAP timeline with duration:1.0 on both opacity tweens.
validated_notes: Used sparingly in canonical referents — only 2/10 used 1.0s crossfades, always for explicit time/memory shift, never for ordinary beat connection. Avoid as default; explicit narrative intent required.
